preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
There are exactly n - 1 edges provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].
The input contains exactly n integers representing vertex values.
Each initial vertex value is an integer with absolute value at most 10^9.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(output, str) and output.strip().isdigit() or (output.strip().startswith('-') and output.strip()[1:].isdigit())
postconditions.description: The output is a single integer string representing the minimum number of moves.

The output integer equals the minimum number of operations required to make all vertex values zero, where an operation consists of selecting a subtree containing vertex 1 and incrementing or decrementing all values in that subtree by 1.
